title: Compose Worlds
scenario: V02 · Predict and replay grazer density
backend: Moxi Python reference SVG and browser Canvas 2D
reproduce:
python3 examples/compose-worlds/build.py
python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist/compose-worlds 8000
Open http://localhost:8000/ at 1180 × 1050 CSS pixels, scale 2. Follow the slide actions.

slides.caption: Identical beds at season zero
slides.expected: The two maps match and the midpoint is 50%.

slides.caption: High feeding response at half cover
slides.action: Focus the rule slider and press End. Leave the prediction at More grazers.
slides.expected: The curve reaches full feeding strength at half cover. Both beds remain at season zero.

slides.caption: Higher grazing consumes the bed
slides.expected: At season 12 the branch averages 21.11% grazers versus 16.47% in the reference. The prediction matches.

slides.caption: Restore the initial bed
slides.expected: Both maps return to season zero and the midpoint returns to 50%. Trial 1 remains in history.

slides.caption: Recover the edited trial
slides.expected: The midpoint returns to 100% and the season-12 maps and densities match the original run. History still contains one trial.
